name: fixed
js: (async () => { const C = window.CITY, a = C.worldFromLatLon(43.6562, -79.3806); const r = C.nearestRoads(a.x, a.z, 80)[0]; const nx = -r.dz, nz = r.dx, off = r.road.w / 2 + 2.5; const px = r.px + nx * off, pz = r.pz + nz * off; window.__CITY_APP.teleportTo(px, pz, Math.atan2(r.dx, r.dz)); await __pcSleep(6000); const T = window.CITY.THREE; __pcHold({ x: px, y: 9, z: pz, lx: px + r.dx * 30, ly: 0, lz: pz + r.dz * 30 }); await __pcSleep(10000); return { px, pz }; })()
